Dehydrated Tomato Flakes Supplier India for Wholesale and Export

Tradenest Naturals is a trusted dehydrated tomato flakes supplier India, delivering consistent and convenient tomato ingredients to food manufacturers, exporters, distributors, restaurants, QSR chains, and private label brands. Crafted from carefully selected ripe tomatoes and processed under controlled food dehydration conditions, our dehydrated tomato flakes retain the characteristic color, aroma, taste, and functional value of fresh produce. As an established manufacturer and dehydrated tomato flakes exporter, we cater to bulk purchasing, customized packing, private label initiatives, and global supply chain requirements. These flakes offer an efficient, practical alternative to fresh tomatoes, granting businesses enhanced shelf stability, minimized preparation time, lower handling losses, and reliable year-round availability. They can be effortlessly rehydrated for cooking or incorporated directly into seasoning systems, instant foods, sauces, soups, bakery items, snack coatings, and ready-to-cook formulations. Contact Tradenest Naturals today to request a product sample, technical specification sheet, packaging proposal, or current dehydrated tomato flakes price.

Product Overview

Our Dehydrated Tomato Flakes are produced by cleaning, sorting, cutting, and drying fresh tomatoes to minimize moisture while intensifying their natural flavor profile. The finished goods are supplied as free-flowing tomato pieces or flakes in practical dimensions suited for industrial food processing and foodservice applications. Depending on the intended use, the flakes can be rehydrated prior to cooking or blended directly into dry mixes. Engineered strictly for B2B applications, the product is available as standard dehydrated tomato flakes or formulated precisely to buyer specifications concerning cut size, moisture targets, packaging formats, label layouts, and functional performance. Our production philosophy ensures seamless batch-to-batch consistency while retaining the agility required to meet diverse market and formulation criteria.

Manufacturing and Processing

Fresh tomatoes undergo rigorous inspection for maturity, visible defects, foreign material, and overall processing suitability. Approved raw materials are thoroughly washed and precision-cut before entering controlled-temperature and airflow dehydrators. This drying stage successfully lowers water activity and ensures long-term storage stability while preserving the authentic identity of the tomato. Following dehydration, the material is cooled, inspected, sieved, and sealed inside food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Comprehensive batch identification and production records ensure complete traceability from raw material intake through final dispatch. When specified, Tradenest Naturals reviews custom parameters regarding particle size, moisture content, microbiological limits, packaging media, and destination-market documentation prior to production sign-off.

Typical Technical Specifications

  • Form: Dried tomato flakes or cut pieces
  • Typical particle size: Approximately 3 to 8 mm; custom sizes available upon review
  • Mesh reference: 8 to 16 mesh equivalent, corresponding to cut profile
  • Moisture: Typically 5% to 8%, subject to agreed specification
  • Purity: Typically 98% minimum, subject to quality agreement
  • Color: Natural red to deep red
  • Flavor: Characteristic sweet, savory, mildly tangy tomato flavor
  • Additives: No added color or flavor in standard products unless explicitly agreed
  • Packaging: Food-grade inner liner with outer carton, bag, jar, or customized export format
Specifications may fluctuate based on tomato variety, seasonal raw material traits, drying parameters, cut dimensions, and unique customer requirements. A finalized product specification and Certificate of Analysis can be finalized for approved orders. Buyers are advised to verify destination-country compliance regarding permitted ingredients, labeling rules, microbiological thresholds, pesticide limits, and allergen declarations prior to commercial dispatch.

Quality, Safety, and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals enforces stringent food safety protocols, covering raw material inspection, moisture regulation, batch tracking, sifting, packaging verification, and routine quality evaluations. Product output is systematically measured against agreed specifications. We make no unverified claims regarding certifications that have not been expressly secured for a specific order or facility. Standard export paperwork includes a product specification sheet, batch details, packing list, commercial invoice, and certificate of origin where applicable. Compliance needs vary widely across buyers, export destinations, and commercial applications. Customers requiring HACCP-aligned systems, ISO-based controls, BRCGS, IFS, organic verification, halal, kosher status, laboratory testing, or pesticide screening must communicate these requirements during the initial inquiry. Tradenest Naturals evaluates feasibility and issues only the documentation directly applicable to the confirmed shipment.

Applications

Bulk dehydrated tomato flakes are celebrated for their concentrated flavor profile, simple handling, and dependable storage characteristics. They serve versatile roles across industries, including:
  • Tomato soups, sauces, gravies, and curry bases
  • Pizza, pasta, noodle, and meal seasoning blends
  • Instant soups, ready-to-cook, and ready-to-eat formulations
  • Snack coatings, namkeen, chips, crackers, and savory mixes
  • Bakery fillings, savory breads, biscuits, and crackers
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering, cloud kitchen, and QSR recipes
  • Dry premixes, spice blends, stuffing mixes, and meal kits
  • Custom food formulations requiring visible tomato inclusions
For sauces, soups, and gravies, the flakes can be easily soaked or simmered with water, stock, oil, or other formulation liquids. In dry seasoning contexts, they blend seamlessly after confirming ideal texture and distribution. Pilot-scale testing is recommended, as rehydration performance relies heavily on cut size, processing variables, recipe composition, and target serving formats.

Buyer Value

  • Longer storage convenience: Reduced moisture levels yield vastly superior shelf stability compared to fresh tomatoes under proper storage conditions.
  • Reduced preparation work: Ready-to-use dried pieces eliminate intensive washing, slicing, trimming, and daily kitchen labor.
  • Year-round availability: Dehydrated formats empower manufacturers to bypass seasonal supply crunches and optimize long-term production schedules.
  • Lower handling losses: Dry flakes are significantly easier to portion, transport, and inventory than highly perishable fresh produce.
  • Consistent formulation input: Controlled cut dimensions and strict specifications guarantee repeatable recipes and standardized batch production.
  • Flexible procurement: Standard, bulk, private label, and custom supply options accommodate businesses of all operational scales.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard commercial packaging spans 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg configurations, dependent on inventory availability and project scope. Export shipments utilize moisture-resistant, food-grade inner liners housed within robust outer cartons or bags. PET jars, HDPE containers, stand-up pouches, bulk super sacks, custom-printed packaging, and private label formats are fully supported for approved projects. The standard shelf life reaches up to 12 months from the date of manufacture when containers remain unopened and are stored under recommended environmental conditions. Final shelf life, packaging details, and expiration dates are explicitly noted on commercial specifications and product labels. Store in a cool, dry, clean environment away from direct sunlight, excessive heat, high humidity, pungent odors, and chemical substances. Always reseal opened containers tightly and use clean, dry utensils to maintain product integrity.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated tomato flakes supplier India? For standard bulk orders, the indicative MOQ is 25 kg. Smaller trial quantities may be accommodated subject to stock levels, packing configurations, and freight logistics. Private label initiatives, custom-printed packaging, specialized cut sizes, tailored specifications, and OEM projects generally carry higher MOQs. Final MOQs are confirmed upon evaluation of the product profile, destination, packaging choice, and volume. Standard lead times range from 7 to 15 working days following the approval of specifications, packaging proofs, payment terms, and order details, subject to raw material availability and production capacity. Tailored or private label orders may require extended windows for artwork approvals, material sourcing, and scheduling. To request a sample or formal price quotation, share your required volume, destination country, preferred packaging, application, target specifications, and private label requirements. Tradenest Naturals will evaluate feasibility, provide precise product data, and issue a comprehensive commercial offer.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals bridges the gap between agricultural manufacturing, bulk supply, export execution, private label packaging, and custom formulation support. Commercial buyers source dehydrated tomato flakes from a dedicated partner centered on practical specifications, transparent communication, and scalable B2B service. Our team assists importers, wholesalers, FMCG brands, food processors, hospitality operators, and distributors with packaging coordination, document verification, and repeat-order planning. Whether you are evaluating wholesale dehydrated tomato flakes, testing a novel ingredient for an industrial formulation, or searching for a dependable dehydrated tomato flakes manufacturer for export channels, we are ready to assist. The final dehydrated tomato flakes price varies according to order volume, seasonality, cut profile, packaging type, testing requirements, destination, and incoterms. Send your inquiry today to discuss the ideal supply structure for your business.

Frequently Asked Questions

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Quality parameters depend entirely on destination-market regulations and buyer specifications. Tradenest Naturals adheres to strict food safety protocols, raw material inspections, moisture thresholds, batch traceability, and quality control procedures. Any specific certifications or testing documentation required must be agreed upon prior to order confirmation.

What are the typical mesh, moisture, and purity values?

Standard product specifications feature an approximate cut profile of 8 to 16 mesh equivalent, moisture levels ranging from 5% to 8%, and a minimum purity benchmark of 98%. Final parameters are locked in via the confirmed product specification sheet.

Can I request a sample?

Yes. Please submit details concerning your application, destination country, required quantity, and preferred specification so our team can verify sample stock and organize shipping arrangements.
